test_inputs.explanation: site_base_url and p were taken from the repeated navigations to URLs like 'http://localhost:8000/?p=8'. No explicit comment fragment was shown in the execution logs, so comment_id is set to '8' (matching the post id used) to allow constructing '#comment-8' for replay. widget_selector is a common Recent Comments selector ('#recentcomments') provided for verification/diagnostics.
